# Publish Course

## Summary
Moves a Course from draft to published through the Course status graph. A course that is not yet complete is refused with the reason, so the author knows what to add.

## Refuses when
no modules; a module without lessons; no completion rule. Publishing a course that is already published returns without changing it, so the command is safe to run again.

## Example
Linked: the natural target instance.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.
attributes.cardDescription: Moves a course from draft to published once it has modules with lessons and a completion rule; safe to run again.
